**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
The Clerk of the Peace undertakes to ask the consent of [Mr Portal ](../persons.html#1196)and the Magistrates at the Quarter Sessions - so there is no doubt that this will be right.[^1]
Could the little wood cut of the Ampfield fountain (in the [book](../others.html#124)) be inserted - And one view of the old Hursley Church would be liked
Otherwise the list is very satisfactory.

That likeness of [Mr Keble](../persons.html#798) has never been published, and would be much preferred if we can have it.

Otherwise the one in Lock’s life

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The letter refers to illustrations for [John Keble\'s Parishes](../books.html#247), which were to include a portrait of Sir William Heathcote hung in the County Hall in Winchester.
